kit.name: Moth-Silk
kit.description: Abilities that hit an enemy leave a Moth on them for 6s (hitting again refreshes it). Your next basic attack on a Mothed enemy releases it for 15 (+3 per level after 1) (+25% bonus AD) bonus magic damage and heals you for 50% of the damage dealt.

kit.name: Silk Snap
kit.description: Flick a silk line 6m from the glaive tip. It stops at the first enemy, dealing 50/85/120/155/190 (+90% bonus AD) physical damage and pinning a Moth. If the target already carried a Moth, the silk snaps taut instead: it is slowed by 40% for 1.25s and its Moth's timer resets to 6s.

kit.name: Cocoon Spin
kit.description: Spin the naginata for 1.25s. You take 35% less damage and move at 80% speed, and enemies within 2.25m take two hits of 20/30/40/50/60 (+30% bonus AD) physical damage. Applies Moths.

kit.name: Moth to Flame
kit.description: Leap on moth wings up to 4m toward the cursor, clearing a wall up to 1.5m thick. On landing, enemies within 1.5m take 60/95/130/165/200 (+70% bonus AD) physical damage, and every Mothed enemy in the ring has its Moth released at once (each release heals you separately). Passive: 15% bonus move speed while moving toward a Mothed enemy champion.

kit.name: Silk Cyclone
kit.description: After a 0.4s wind-up, reel every Mothed enemy champion within 9m to the edge of a 3.5m ring around you (terrain stops the reel), spending their Moths. Then spin for 2s, unstoppable, dealing 4 hits of 50/85/120 (+40% bonus AD) physical damage and a 30% slow to every enemy in the ring.

kit.name: The Canker
kit.description: Abilities infect the target with a Canker, dealing magic damage every second. Damage to the host from any other source fills a hidden meter. Filling the meter or killing the host bursts the Canker, damaging enemies nearby and giving each a weaker Canker. A Canker that expires does nothing. Any unit that dies carrying one restores mana.

kit.name: Feed
kit.description: Fire a bolt of fel light for magic damage.

kit.name: Shared Cup
kit.description: Fire a 7m bolt that stops at the first enemy and deals 30 (+20% AP) magic damage to it - but the first-generation Canker goes to the enemy standing nearest that body within 3m (the body itself if it stands alone).

kit.name: Gather
kit.description: Slow every cankered enemy nearby and pull cankered champions a step toward each other. You gain movement speed.

kit.name: Contagion
kit.description: Seed a wide area with fresh Cankers. For 10s your Cankers cost less to burst, burst 50% wider, and spread a second generation to champions.

kit.name: Ground Covered
kit.description: Four seconds of uninterrupted travel grants bonus movement speed, lost when a champion damages you. Near your own Milestones you take less damage and attack faster.

kit.name: Plumb Drop
kit.description: Drop the brass plumb bob on a point within 5m. After 0.5s it lands in a 1.25m circle for 70/110/150/190/230 (+80% AD) physical damage and a 25% slow for 1s. If one of your Milestones stands within 8m of where it lands, a sighting line runs from the stone to the bob and every enemy along it takes the same damage.

kit.name: Set Stone
kit.description: Plant a Milestone at your feet, to a maximum of two. It grants vision to your team and hastens allies near it. Only champions and turrets can destroy it, and both teams can see it.

kit.name: Twenty-Two Yards
kit.description: Throw the chain to tether an enemy champion for 2.5s. Neither of you can move beyond the chain's length; whoever crosses it is pulled back, damaged and slowed.

kit.name: The Long Walk
kit.description: Channel for 4s, then travel to one of your Milestones and arrive with a shield. Hard crowd control, enough damage, or destroying the Milestone cancels it.

kit.name: Bellows Pressure
kit.description: Pressure runs 0 to 100 and refills 4 a second. Your attacks are gouts of flame that spend 8 Pressure and splash down a jet behind the target that scales with the gauge: 0.5m and 25% of the blow when empty, up to 3m and 45% at full. Attacks on a target already burning (from Gout or White Heat) refund 3 Pressure.

kit.name: Gout
kit.description: A cone of fire that spends up to 40 Pressure: physical damage, 1% more per Pressure spent, and a burn.

kit.name: Pump
kit.description: Hold to work the bellows for up to 2s: +45 Pressure a second, but you are slowed by 40% and cannot attack. Release (or press again) to stop. A full pump gives your next 3 attacks 30% attack speed.

kit.name: Backdraft
kit.description: Blast the nozzle at the ground and rocket away. Enemies where you took off take physical damage and are slowed by 30% for 1s.

kit.name: White Heat
kit.description: Needs 100 Pressure. Swell for 0.75s, then a white-hot blast in a long cone: physical damage, a 3s burn and healing cut by 40% for 4s. Then you Overheat: Pressure drops to 0 and cannot refill for 3s.

kit.name: Stigmata
kit.description: Damage redirected onto you is Toll: it ignores armour, shields and all reduction. Every 60 Toll grants a Grudge, each adding attack damage and increasing The Reckoning.

kit.name: Knotted Cord
kit.description: Swing a weighted cord in an arc for damage and a brief slow, with bonus damage to minions.

kit.name: Share the Wound
kit.description: Tie a cord to an ally for 8s. A third of the damage they take is redirected onto you as Toll. Beyond its range the cord goes slack and redirects nothing.

kit.name: Take My Place
kit.description: Dash to your tethered ally and swap places, damaging and slowing enemies you pass through.

kit.name: The Reckoning
kit.description: For 3.5s all damage dealt to allies near you is redirected onto you, and Grudge builds twice as fast. It then detonates, damaging and slowing enemies around you for a share of the Toll taken. Dying during it detonates at 60%.

kit.name: Hiss of the Quench
kit.description: Each basic attack adds 12 Heat and each ability that hits adds 20 (max 100, seen by both teams). It cools 10 per second after 3s out of combat. Whenever Heat leaves the bar (cooling, a white-hot Strike While Hot or Quench) the steam shields you for 3s: 1.2 per Heat lost over the last 2s, capped at 12% of your max health, refreshed with each loss. At 100 Heat your next Strike While Hot Brands.

kit.name: Strike While Hot
kit.description: Slam the anvil 3m ahead into a 2.25m circle: 70/110/150/190/230 (+0.6 AD) physical damage and a 35% slow for 1.5s. At 100 Heat it spends it all, stuns for 0.75s and Brands everyone hit for 5s: the next hit from your side on a Branded enemy deals +5% of their max health as magic damage.

kit.name: Work the Iron
kit.description: For 3s you hammer in rhythm: +40% attack speed, attacks add double Heat, and you take 15% less damage.

kit.name: Anvil Drop
kit.description: Leap to a point within 6m and slam down: enemies within 2.25m are knocked up for 0.75s and take 60/95/130/165/200 (+0.5 AD) physical damage (+20 Heat per champion hit).

kit.name: Quench
kit.description: Plunge the hammer into the ground: a scalding steam cloud bursts 5m round you for 4s, spending all Heat. Enemies inside take 30/45/60 magic damage per second (+1% per Heat spent) and are slowed 25%. Enemies outside cannot see in: it hides your team like brush. You gain 30/40/50 armour and magic resist for the duration.

kit.name: Light to Shoot By
kit.description: Your basic attacks against a target in your light (lit by a Flare Round, standing in a Storm Lantern, or revealed by the Dawnwatch) reach 1m further and ignore 10% of its armour. Eighty years of practice: you cannot be blinded.

kit.name: Flare Round
kit.description: Your next shot deals bonus damage, reveals its target for 4s, and resets your attack timer. Attacking a revealed target grants stacking attack speed.

kit.name: Storm Lantern
kit.description: Throw a lantern that stands for 45s, granting vision around it and slowing enemies in its light. Two may stand at once, and two hits destroy one.

kit.name: Foghorn
kit.description: Sound the lamp-gun's horn: enemies within 3m are pushed 1.5m directly away and slowed by 30% for 1s; enemies in your light are pushed 2.5m instead. You gain 20% move speed for 1.5s.

kit.name: The Dawnwatch
kit.description: Light the great lamp. The beam sweeps a full circle over 4s, damaging, slowing and revealing everything it passes. You may walk slowly while it turns.

kit.name: Firn
kit.description: Your ice is solid to enemies and passable to allies, who cross it faster, and it blocks projectiles from both teams. Near your own ice you take 15% less damage.

kit.name: Icecutter
kit.description: Send a crack racing down a line for magic damage and a slow.

kit.name: Calving Shelf
kit.description: Aim a point within 7m. After 0.5s a shelf of ice grows out of the nearest wall, or the nearest of your own ice, within 4m of that point, extending 3m toward it in three segments that stand 6s: solid to enemies, open to allies, four champion hits each to break. With nothing to grow from, a two-segment stub rises at the point. Recast on the shelf to shatter all of it for 70/105/140/175/210 (+40% AP) magic damage and a 1m shove each, at half the cooldown and no mana. Two shelves at most.

kit.name: Black Ice
kit.description: Freeze a strip of ground for 8s. Allies cross it faster, enemies slower, and you fastest.

kit.name: The Slow Winter
kit.description: Raise a 6m-wide front of ice at your feet that creeps forward along your aim at 1.5m a second for 5s. Enemies it meets are pushed ahead of it (pinned 0.75s if pressed into a wall); it blocks enemy shots and movement, and allies walk through it. Recast, or let its time run out, and the whole front shatters for 200/300/400 (+60% AP) magic damage and a 1.5m shove.

kit.name: The Open Tap
kit.description: You have no mana. Abilities cost current health and cannot be cast if the cost would take you below 15% of maximum. Health spent becomes Owed, which your curses repay. Enemies carrying one of your curses deal 10% less damage to you. Out of combat you regenerate quickly.

kit.name: Utterance
kit.description: Send one syllable down a line, stopping on the first enemy. Hitting the host of the Word restarts it. A kill refunds the health it cost.

kit.name: The Word
kit.description: Costs 9% of current health. Curse one enemy champion within 6.25m for 7s: 14/23/32/41/50 (+14% AP) magic damage per second, 20% more for every second it has run. If it runs its full length the sentence finishes: the host is silenced for 1s and you are repaid 150% of the health it cost over 2s. If the host dies you are repaid all of it and the Word simply ends. Utterance on the host starts it over. Only one Word at a time.

kit.name: Second Hand
kit.description: The Word's host convulses, applying a weaker, briefer Echo to every other champion near them. Echoes repay nothing. If no one is in range it does not cast and costs nothing.

kit.name: The Congregation
kit.description: Costs 25% of current health. Set your censers down at a point within 7m: a 5m ring of smoke for 8s that slows enemies by 15%. Every enemy champion inside hears a step of the sermon each second (kept for 2s after leaving) and takes 22/33/44 (+10% AP) magic damage per second, 20% more per step heard. Anyone who hears all 8 steps repays you 25% of what you are Owed. While the smoke burns, your out-of-combat regeneration is shut.

kit.name: Faultline
kit.description: Your abilities crack the ground into glowing Faults for 6s, seen by both teams. Enemies standing on a Fault are slowed 15% and take 10% more damage from you; standing on one you take 10% less damage.

kit.name: Kanabo Drive
kit.description: Smash forward: a Fault races 7m down a line, dealing 70/110/150/190/230 (+0.6 AD) physical damage and slowing 30% for 1s.

kit.name: Rune-Iron
kit.description: The club's runes blaze for 3s: you take 25% less damage and are immune to slows. When it ends the runes vent in a 3m burst for 40/65/90/115/140 + 25% of the damage you took during it, and crack a ring of Fault under you.

kit.name: Oni Charge
kit.description: Charge 6m dragging the kanabo: enemies you pass are knocked aside 1.5m and take 60/95/130/165/200 (+0.5 AD) physical damage, and the path behind you becomes a Fault.

kit.name: Ringbreaker
kit.description: Slam the kanabo. After 0.6s the ground splits in a 5.5m ring with six spokes. Every enemy on any Fault within 8m (the new ring, its spokes and every older Fault) is pinned for 1.25/1.5/1.75s and takes 150/250/350 (+0.8 AD) physical damage; enemies elsewhere inside the ring are slowed 40% for 1.5s.

kit.name: Ember Heart
kit.description: Damage you take, after mitigation, fills Ember: 1 per 1% of your max health lost, up to 100, shown to both teams as the glow in your chest. Each 10 Ember grants 2 armour and 2 magic resist. Ember cools 5 per second after 5s out of combat.

kit.name: Quartz Line
kit.description: Punch the ground: quartz spikes run down a 6.5m line for 70/110/150/190/230 (+4% bonus health) magic damage and a 30% slow for 1.5s. At 50+ Ember the first champion hit is also knocked up for 0.5s.

kit.name: Refract
kit.description: Catch the light for 2.5s: 25% damage reduction. When it ends you fire a rainbow beam at each enemy champion that damaged you during it (up to 3): 40/60/80/100/120 magic damage plus 30% of the damage they dealt you.

kit.name: Faceted Charge
kit.description: Charge 4.25m, stopping on the first enemy champion: they take 60/90/120/150/180 (+5% bonus health) physical damage and are pinned for 0.5s (1s at 50+ Ember) while three quartz shards rise in a 3m arc behind them, standing 2s as a wall to everyone but your team. No shove.

kit.name: Shatter and Reform
kit.description: Spend all Ember. Your body bursts outward: 150/250/350 (+60% AP) magic damage within 4.5m, +1% per Ember spent, knocking enemies 2m away. You are untargetable shards for 1.25s, then reform at a point within 4.5m of where you burst, with a shield of 100/175/250 plus 2 per Ember spent for 3s.

kit.name: The Little Ghost
kit.description: Every 12s the next allied champion her abilities touch keeps her ghost wisp for 4s. The first champion to hit them loses 40 (+10 per level) (+15% AP) of that damage to the wisp and is spooked, slowed 30% for 1s.

kit.name: Spirit Round
kit.description: Fire a ghost round down a line. It passes through allied champions, shielding each for 2s, and stops on the first enemy: magic damage and a 25% slow for 1.25s.

kit.name: Haunt
kit.description: Send the little ghost at an enemy champion. It is Haunted for 4s, taking magic damage over the duration; the first ability from one of her allies to hit it pops the Haunt for the same again and it flees in terror from Hana.

kit.name: Ghost Step
kit.description: Half-step into the spirit world for 2s: walk through units with 35% movement speed that fades over the duration, and cut 3s off the next Spirit Round.

kit.name: Séance
kit.description: Lay a 5m ring of ghost candles at a point within 7m for 6s. Allied champions inside when it lands are shielded for 100/160/220 (+40% AP) for 3s, and allies inside regenerate 2% of their max health per second. The first time each enemy champion crosses into the ring the little ghost pops up in their face: they are feared straight back out for 0.6s, then slowed by 30% for 1s. The first ally shielded receives the Little Ghost's wisp.

kit.name: Lessons Learned
kit.description: You earn Lessons: 2 for a champion takedown, 1 for dying to a champion, 1 for an epic monster your team takes near you. Your training sword grows on them: Iron at 4 (+10 attack damage), Oak at 9 (+20 attack damage, +0.25m attack range), Steel at 15 (+35 attack damage, +0.5m attack range, basic attacks cleave 40% in a 90-degree 2.5m arc), and never later than levels 7, 12 and 17. Below Iron, basic attacks deal 8% less to champions. Practice Swing's second cut unlocks at Iron and its gold wave at Steel.

kit.name: Practice Swing
kit.description: Slash a 120-degree arc out to 2.75m for 55/90/125/160/195 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage. From Iron (level 6) a second cut follows for 40% on everything the first one hit. At Steel (level 16) a gold wave also runs 6m down the line for 60%.

kit.name: Paper Crane
kit.description: Gain a shield of 60/90/120/150/180 (+10% max health) for 2.5s and 25% movement speed for 1.5s. If an enemy champion breaks the shield, Practice Swing comes off cooldown.

kit.name: Running Start
kit.description: Dash 3.5m toward the cursor. The first enemy champion you pass is struck for 50/80/110/140/170 (+60% bonus AD) physical damage, and your next basic attack within 3s strikes twice.

kit.name: Borrowed Steel
kit.description: For 6s your sword jumps one stage past its current one (at Steel it becomes Gold: +50 attack damage, +0.75m attack range, 60% cleave). Practice Swing throws its gold wave and its cooldown is halved, and each enemy champion hit by Practice Swing or Running Start extends the window by 0.5s (up to 3s). A takedown during it permanently grants +3 attack damage (up to 5 times).

kit.name: Calling It
kit.description: Every ability you cast is drawn on the ground for both teams for its whole wind-up. When one lands, allies near it are Braced with a shield and a burst of attack speed, once per 5s each.

kit.name: Wallop
kit.description: Wind up, then slam for damage and a heavy slow, with bonus damage to minions.

kit.name: Assignments
kit.description: Mark an enemy champion for 5s. Your allies, but not you, deal bonus damage to them, and anyone near them on cast is Braced. If the marked target dies, a quarter of your cooldowns is refunded.

kit.name: Call the Pull
kit.description: Drive the maul in and count down for 1.5s, then knock up everyone inside the shrinking ring. You may walk slowly. Hard crowd control cancels the count and refunds half the mana.

kit.name: Crash Out
kit.description: For 10s at every rank, gain movement speed and attack speed and cast without wind-ups. Your passive is disabled for the duration.

kit.name: The Kiln Never Goes Out
kit.description: The kiln stokes a charge of Clay every 12s and holds three; the count is visible to both teams. A clayfolk that dies shatters for magic damage and leaves bisque that slows.

kit.name: Throwing Clay
kit.description: Hurl a lump of clay for damage and a slow where it lands. Landing it on one of your clayfolk repairs it instead and doubles its next swing.

kit.name: Fire a Clayfolk
kit.description: Spend a Clay to fire a clayfolk at a nearby point. Fired within reach of an enemy, it attacks that enemy for its first 6 seconds; otherwise it attacks whatever you are attacking, or the nearest enemy champion within 6, and with nothing to fight it waits beside you. It blocks enemy champion movement.

kit.name: Handoff
kit.description: Swap places with one of your clayfolk. The one arriving where you stood gains movement speed briefly.

kit.name: The Great Firing
kit.description: Glaze every living clayfolk for 12s: more health, larger, faster-swinging and harder to break. You refill to three Clay, and if fewer than two clayfolk stand, two are fired at your feet first.

kit.name: Star-Catcher
kit.description: Every 15s (down to 9s at level 18) a star falls near her and lies there for 8s. An allied champion who walks over it heals 30 (+10 per level) and gains 20% movement speed for 2s; if Hoshimi catches it she bottles it in a jar instead (up to 2). An enemy who walks over it stamps it out.

kit.name: Wishing Star
kit.description: Flick a star 9.5m down a line. The first enemy hit takes 60/95/130/165/200 (+40% AP) magic damage. Where it stops (the body it hit, or the end of its range) it leaves a star on the ground for 3s (5s if it hit a champion): an allied champion who catches it heals 40/55/70/85/100 (+30% AP), Hoshimi catching it bottles it in a jar under Star-Catcher's rules, and an enemy can stamp it out.

kit.name: Hang a Star
kit.description: Hang a star over an allied champion or herself for 5s, healing every second. If they drop below 40% health from champion damage it falls at once and heals the rest in one go, 30% stronger. Two may hang at a time; a jar makes it free and 50% stronger.

kit.name: Star Net
kit.description: Throw the star net down a line. The first enemy champion is caught: rooted and dealt magic damage. Minions and monsters block it.

kit.name: Falling Star
kit.description: Call a star down on a point. After 1.25s it lands: allies are healed; enemies take magic damage and are blinded. A catchable star rests in the crater for 4s.

kit.name: Late Stroke
kit.description: Everything you land leaves a Stroke. Three seconds later it falls, dealing its damage and healing you for most of it. Dying voids every outstanding Stroke. No one else can heal or shield you.

kit.name: Backswing
kit.description: Cut through the arc in front of you. Recast for the return swing back across it.

kit.name: Stay
kit.description: For 2.5s most damage you take is deferred into a pool instead of landing, then arrives over the following 3s. Strokes that fall in the meantime pay the pool down first.

kit.name: Downstroke
kit.description: Drive the point in. Every Stroke resting on a champion nearby falls at once at reduced value, slowing whoever loses one.

kit.name: On Time
kit.description: For a few seconds Strokes land the instant they are applied and heal for more, and every outstanding Stroke falls on cast. Afterwards new Strokes take 5s to fall instead of 3.

kit.name: Lightning Rod
kit.description: Each ability hit plants a brass rod on that enemy for 4s. When Thunderhead strikes and a rodded enemy is within 3m of its centre, the bolt jumps to them: it re-centres on their position and deals 30 (+20% AP) more magic damage to them, spending the rod. Arc Bolt hitting a rodded enemy forks 4m to the nearest other enemy for 50% of its damage, spending the rod.

kit.name: Arc Bolt
kit.description: Fire a lightning bolt in a line, damaging the first enemy hit. Minions block it.

kit.name: Thunderhead
kit.description: After 0.6s, lightning strikes a circle, damaging and slowing everyone inside.

kit.name: Skyward Step
kit.description: Dash toward your cursor and gain 20% movement speed for 2s. The cooldown is 40% shorter if you damaged an enemy in the last 3s.

kit.name: Charged Sky
kit.description: Summon a thundercloud over a 5m circle within 8m for 4s. Every 0.75s a bolt picks an enemy champion inside (a rodded one first, otherwise any, otherwise a random point) and rings their feet; 0.5s later it strikes a 1.2m circle for 70/105/140 (+25% AP) magic damage. A champion struck twice in one cast is stunned for 1s. Moving dodges; standing still does not.

kit.name: Stoke the Rings
kit.description: Basic attacks add 8 Blaze and abilities that hit add 15. Every 25 Blaze grants 5% attack speed. At 100 his rings ignite for 3s: Blaze drains away and cannot be gained, every ability he casts is Red-Hot, and his basic attacks deal 15 bonus magic damage. Blaze cools 10 per second after 4s out of combat.

kit.name: Hammer and Anvil
kit.description: Two punches down a line, 0.25s apart, physical damage each; the second knocks enemies back. Red-Hot: the second punch stuns champions for 0.5s.

kit.name: Quench
kit.description: Vent the rings in a burst of steam: magic damage around him and a 30% slow for 1.5s, and he heals for 4% of his maximum health. Red-Hot: 60% more heal, and the steam lingers 2s, slowing anyone who stays.

kit.name: Not For You!
kit.description: Dash to a champion. At an enemy: punch on arrival for physical damage. At an ally: land between them and the nearest enemy champion and cover them for 2.5s: 40% of the damage enemy champions deal them is dealt to Kazuki instead, and every 2% of his maximum health he takes this way adds 2 Blaze. Red-Hot: the punch is 30% stronger, or he takes 60% and burns off the ally's slows.

kit.name: Forge-Line
kit.description: Crouch for 0.35s with the line glowing ahead, then rocket 9m down it, unstoppable, straight through everyone: each enemy champion passed takes physical damage (minions and monsters half). The line burns for 4s, dealing magic damage each second, slowing enemies on it by 25% and cutting their healing by 40%. Arriving fills his Blaze.

kit.name: Waiting On
kit.description: Your basic attacks are lure throws. While the kestrel is on your fist and you have not attacked for 1.5s, it climbs and gains Height (1 per second, max 3; twice as fast with your Quarry within 8). Your next attack on a champion spends all Height: the kestrel stoops for 15% of your attack damage + 1.5% of their missing health per Height as bonus physical damage, from overhead, so nothing that blocks shots stops it.

kit.name: Lure Swing
kit.description: Swing the weighted lure through a 110-degree arc in front of you: physical damage to every enemy hit and a 1 shove outward. The nearest champion struck becomes Quarry for 6s: revealed to your team, and your kestrel climbs twice as fast while it is near.

kit.name: Creance Flight
kit.description: The kestrel flies out along an 11 line on its training cord and back over 1.5s. Enemies along the way are revealed for 3s; the first enemy champion it passes is stooped on (a full-Height stoop), slowed by 35% for 1.5s and made Quarry. Sending it out spends its Height.

kit.name: Bate
kit.description: Hop away in a fury of wings. Enemies close to where you took off are blinded for 1s (longer with rank): their basic attacks miss.

kit.name: Out of Sight
kit.description: The kestrel climbs out of sight. After 1.5s it stoops on the lowest-health enemy champion near you (Quarry first), then twice more 1s apart, choosing again each time. Each stoop is marked by a ring 0.75s before it lands and hits whoever is in the ring for physical damage + 12% of their missing health. You can keep attacking.

kit.name: One Spear
kit.description: Ketta has one trident. Planted, it is a visible object anyone can stand on; while it is planted her attacks are fists at 125 range for 50% damage and she cannot cast Q. Walking onto it picks it up. Spear hits on champions add a Notch (max 5) that the throw spends: +8% damage and +0.1s pin each.

kit.name: Thrown Spear
kit.description: Throw the trident 800 units, stopping on the first enemy champion: physical damage and a pin (0.75s +0.15s per rank) where they stand. The spear plants at their feet, or at the end of the line if it hits nothing.

kit.name: Run Down
kit.description: Gain 30% move speed for 2.5s. If the spear is planted the speed is doubled toward it, and reaching it during the buff refunds half of W's cooldown.

kit.name: Call It Back
kit.description: The planted trident tears free and flies back to her hand from up to 900 units, hitting everyone on the line for physical damage and knocking them aside; a champion still pinned by it takes 40% more.

kit.name: The Long Throw
kit.description: After a 0.75s wind-up, hurl the trident in an arc up to 1400 units. It plants where it lands and pins every enemy champion within 250 for 1.5s with physical damage, doubled on the champion it lands on. For 8s the planted spear is a marker both teams see through fog, and W toward it is tripled.

kit.name: Tied Off
kit.description: Overhealing becomes a shield worth 40% of the excess, to a maximum of 8% of the target's health, for 3s. Stitches that expire on their own refund 30 mana.

kit.name: Needle Dart
kit.description: Throw the needle in a piercing line, damaging enemies and healing allies, then it returns to you and hits everything a second time.

kit.name: Stitch
kit.description: Sew a thread between two nearby units, to a maximum of two threads. Threaded allies echo half of your heals to each other and split damage; threaded enemies share 25% of everything either takes. Recast on a thread to Snip it, healing allies or burning enemies.

kit.name: Basting Pins
kit.description: Scatter pins in an area, damaging and slowing enemies inside. The first to leave is rooted briefly.

kit.name: The Grand Seam
kit.description: Sew a seam across the battlefield for 5s. Allies crossing it are healed and hastened once; enemies crossing take damage and are slowed, shared by every Stitched enemy.

kit.name: Undertow
kit.description: Attacks and abilities apply a stack of Brine, to a maximum of 3. At 3 stacks the target is slowed 30% for 1.5s and Chain Sweep fouls them twice as long.

kit.name: Chain Sweep
kit.description: Haul the chain taut between you and your Mooring (up to 10m of it). Every enemy on it takes 70/110/150/190/230 (+60% AP) magic damage and is fouled: pinned for 0.6s, or 1.2s at 3 Brine. With no Mooring, lash the chain 6m straight ahead instead.

kit.name: Breakwall
kit.description: Plant or relocate the Mooring within 14m, visible to both teams and sunk by 3 enemy hits. Where it lands, its chain lies 6m back toward you as a boom for 2s: enemies cannot walk or dash over it; allies and projectiles pass. Replanting lays a new chain.

kit.name: Breakwater
kit.description: Sweep the chain around you, damaging enemies and knocking them away from the Mooring, or away from you if none stands.

kit.name: Weigh Anchor
kit.description: Haul the Mooring home: its path is drawn, then over 1s the anchor drags along the ground to your feet. Every enemy champion within 1.5m of its path is snagged and dragged along with it, arriving stunned for 1s and taking 180/270/360 (+70% AP) magic damage (20% more if Brined). With no Mooring down, you first hurl the anchor 10m ahead, then haul. The Mooring then sits at your feet.

kit.name: Straws
kit.description: Each instance of damage Mei takes from an enemy champion adds one Straw (max 15), tallied above her head for both teams. Each Straw grants +1.5% total damage dealt. Any single source grants at most 1 Straw per second; after 8s without champion damage, marks fade one per second. At 12 Straws she becomes THE HAUNTING: +15% move speed, Flinch loses its gate, attack reach 200 to 300, stacks drain 1/s and champion hits restore 1. The haunting holds while any Straw remains.

kit.name: Bag Swing
kit.description: Mei swings the satchel in a 225-unit arc for physical damage. That's it.

kit.name: Take It
kit.description: Instantly cover up for 2s (+0.1s per rank): incoming damage is reduced 45%, and every hit taken during the window grants +1 extra Straw. No shield, no root - she can walk while enduring.

kit.name: Flinch
kit.description: Castable only within 2.5s of taking champion damage (ungated while THE HAUNTING holds): Mei skips 250 units in the aimed direction, instantly.

kit.name: Enough.
kit.description: Mei finally raises her voice: a 375-radius burst dealing physical damage +10% per Straw. Out of the form it consumes all her Straws - 10 or more stuns enemies hit for 0.75s, otherwise they are slowed 40% for 1.5s. While THE HAUNTING holds, the scream is the ghost's own: it reads her current count, always stuns, spends nothing and does not end the form.

kit.name: Chalk and Memory
kit.description: When an enemy champion leaves your team's vision, their last known position and heading are marked for 4s. They can see their own mark.

kit.name: Sightline
kit.description: Fire a brass beam down a line. The first champion hit is damaged and revealed, and is told they were revealed. It deals more damage the further it travelled, and a beam that passes one of your stakes continues from there.

kit.name: Benchmark
kit.description: Plant a survey stake granting 6 units of vision for 90s, with two charges. It has 1 health, so anything destroys it, and pays 15 gold to whoever does.

kit.name: Run the Line
kit.description: Dash up to 6m straight toward the standing Benchmark stake nearest your cursor within 10m, stopping at it; with no stake in reach, hop 3m toward the cursor. The dash removes all slows, its path is chalked on the ground for both teams, and the stake you reach sees 9m for 3s.

kit.name: Triangulation
kit.description: Survey the triangle between you and your two standing stakes for 6s (with fewer than two stakes, a 70-degree wedge 12m long toward your cursor). Enemy champions inside are revealed to your team, slowed by 15% and chalked with their heading; allied champions inside move 15% faster. You are revealed to the enemy for the 6s. No damage.

kit.name: Rivet Line
kit.description: Every 4th basic attack fires a rivet that punches straight through: it hits the target and everything in a 5 line behind it for 70% damage, and Tags enemy champions for 6s (revealed to your team).

kit.name: Drum Dump
kit.description: Empty the drum: 70% attack speed for 2.5s, and each attack counts twice toward Rivet Line.

kit.name: Spotting Flare
kit.description: Fire a flare that lights a circle for 5s for your team. After 0.6s it bursts: enemies inside take physical damage and are Tagged.

kit.name: Boot Jets
kit.description: Hop on steam jets. Your next basic attack within 3s is a Rivet Line.

kit.name: Walker Strike
kit.description: Mark a line that starts up to 6 out toward the cursor. After 1s the walker strides along it: five footfalls 4 apart, 0.4s between, each stamping its drawn circle for physical damage and a 0.5s knock-up. A footfall near a Tagged champion lands on them. Later footfalls deal half to anyone already stamped.

kit.name: Loose Fit
kit.description: The suit is three pieces: helm, breastplate and greaves. Each worn piece gives +8 armour and magic resist and 4% damage reduction. When an enemy champion hits Mochi, at most once every 3s, a piece clatters off and lies on the ground 1.5m behind him for 8s. Walk over it to put it back on and heal 3% of your max health; an enemy who walks over it kicks it 3m away, and an unclaimed piece returns on its own after 8s. With no pieces on, the blob scurries at +25% move speed.

kit.name: Clang
kit.description: A shield bash in a line. The first enemy it reaches is hurt and stunned for 1s.

kit.name: Tin Kettle
kit.description: Mochi squeaks. The most wounded ally champion within 5m (Mochi included) is healed and hastened by 20% for 1.5s.

kit.name: Roly-Poly
kit.description: A short roll. Minions and monsters in the way are shoved aside and hurt; champions are not.

kit.name: Pile On
kit.description: The pieces you are wearing collapse into a door where Mochi stood, across the way Mochi hops, for 4s: 3.5m wide with the whole suit, a quarter less for each missing piece. Mochi hops out untargetable and lands at the aim point. The pieces stay in the door while it stands and come back when it falls.

kit.name: Paid in Full
kit.description: The candle burns down in combat and relights out of it. The more of it is lit, the more damage you deal and the less you take. Landing an ability on an enemy champion restores candle.

kit.name: Doorbreaker
kit.description: Cleave a wide arc in front of you. Hitting an enemy champion refunds half the cooldown and restores candle; minions and monsters refund nothing.

kit.name: I Am Still Coming
kit.description: For 2.5s you are immune to slows, crowd control on you is 60% shorter, you walk through units, and you gain 25% movement speed.

kit.name: The Toll
kit.description: Strike one target for weapon damage plus 6% of their maximum health, capped against non-champions. Enemies below 8% health are executed, and a kill relights the candle in full.

kit.name: Seizure Notice
kit.description: After a 0.4s wind-up, nail a notice to every enemy champion in a 7m, 100-degree cone in front of you. For 5s each notice tallies the damage its holder deals to anyone. When it expires the holder takes 80/120/160 + 35% of their tally as true damage, and you relight 10 candle for each notice paid. While your notices stand, your candle does not burn.

kit.name: Between Rounds
kit.description: Roar (0-100, seen by both teams) comes only from landing hits on enemy champions: 6 per basic attack, 10 per ability hit. Your first champion hit starts a 20s round. When the bell rings you heal 1% max health per 10 Roar held, gain 20% movement speed for 2s and refresh Bob and Weave, then your Roar halves and the next round starts if you are still fighting. After 6s out of combat the round and your Roar reset. Encore: any ability cast with 50 or more Roar spends 50 for that ability's Encore.

kit.name: Bob and Weave
kit.description: Sidestep 2.5m in any direction. If you end within 2.25m of an enemy champion, your next basic attack within 2.5s is a counter-jab that deals bonus physical damage and earns 6 Roar. Encore: you can sidestep again once within 2s.

kit.name: Clinch
kit.description: Grab an adjacent enemy champion and tie them to you for 1.5s on a 1.5m leash: walking past it snaps them back, a dash or blink breaks it. Both of you are slowed by 30% and you take 20% less damage from them. Recast, or let it run out, to break with an uppercut that deals physical damage and knocks them up for 0.5s. Encore: the uppercut deals 50% more damage.

kit.name: Off the Ropes
kit.description: Dash up to 4.5m. If you meet a wall, or cross the ropes of your Ring while it stands, you rebound 4m back along the line with a clothesline that deals physical damage, stuns the first enemy champion hit for 0.75s and slows everything else by 40% for 1s. In open ground it is only a dash. Encore: you rebound even in open ground.

kit.name: Title Bout
kit.description: Raise the Ring (4.5m radius) at your feet for 6/7/8s with an opening bell: enemies inside take physical damage and are slowed by 40% for 1s. The ropes never block. An enemy champion who leaves the Ring is Called Out for 4s: you move 25% faster toward them, and your next basic attack on them deals 100 (+60% AD) bonus physical damage. Your Roar gain doubles while you stand inside. Encore: the Ring is 1m wider.

kit.name: Light Fingers
kit.description: Every third hit (attacks or abilities) on an enemy champion picks their pocket, once per champion every 12s: steal 4 gold (+1 per 3 levels) and roll Loot for 4s: 20% movement speed, 25% attack speed, or a 40 (+8 per level) shield.

kit.name: Hook and Swipe
kit.description: Rake both hooks through a 2.5 m cone for 45/75/105/135/165 (+0.8 bonus AD) physical damage. Champions hit count twice toward Light Fingers.

kit.name: Rooftop Run
kit.description: Hook an enemy or terrain within 5 m and haul yourself to it. On terrain, vault to the far side of a wall up to 2.5 m thick; on an enemy champion, land beside them and slow them 30% for 1s.

kit.name: Dropped Purse
kit.description: Toss a jingling coin purse to a point within 7m; it lies there for 4s. The first enemy champion to step within 1m takes the bait and is Marked for 4s (visible to all). You gain 25% movement speed while moving toward a Marked target, and your next basic attack on them picks their pocket at once, ignoring the 12s lockout, and slows them by 30% for 1s. Minions ignore the purse.

kit.name: The Heist
kit.description: Mark a 4.5 m ring at a point within 7 m and sprint its circumference in 1s, untargetable, dealing 120/180/240 (+0.7 bonus AD) physical damage to everyone you pass and picking every champion's pocket regardless of lockout. Enemies inside the ring are slowed 40% while you run. You end where you started.

kit.name: Swept Clean
kit.description: Any ally you move with Shoo! (including yourself) is shaken free of slows and shielded for 50 (+12 per level) (+0.3 AP) for 2.5s.

kit.name: Sweep
kit.description: Sweep the broom in a 3.5m arc in front of you: 60/95/130/165/200 (+0.5 AP) magic damage, and enemies are swept 2m away from you.

kit.name: Shoo!
kit.description: Target an ally champion within 7m (or none, for yourself) and aim: a gust carries them 4m that way, through units. It moves stunned and pinned allies too (it does not end the stun). Triggers Swept Clean.

kit.name: Broomstick
kit.description: Ride the broom 5m in the aimed direction, passing through units. For 3s your path stays a trail of dry leaves where allies move 20% faster and enemies 15% slower.

kit.name: Salted Threshold
kit.description: Pour an 8m straight line of salt, centred up to 6m away and laid across your aim, for 4s. It does not stop walking: enemy dashes and blinks that try to cross it end on the line, and each enemy who walks across it takes 120/200/280 (+0.6 AP) magic damage once and is slowed by 60%, fading over 1.5s. Allies and projectiles pass freely.

kit.name: Fed Ground
kit.description: Enemy units that die inside your Garden or within 3m of you feed the ground: you heal 14 (+2% of your max health for a champion), and a standing Garden grows 0.3m wider and lasts 0.5s longer per death (up to +2m and +3s). Overgrowth holds the fed size.

kit.name: Thornlash
kit.description: A vine whip lashes out in a line, damaging and slowing everything it touches. Lashing through your garden deals 40% more damage and slows harder.

kit.name: The Garden
kit.description: Sow a circle of carnivorous growth for 5s. Enemies inside are damaged every second and slowed, and you regenerate 2% of your health per second while standing in it. One garden at a time.

kit.name: Flytrap
kit.description: A flytrap snaps shut from the ground after a moment, damaging and rooting everyone above it. Cast inside your garden it snaps twice as fast and holds 50% longer.

kit.name: Overgrowth
kit.description: Root yourself for 4s. You gain heavy damage reduction, your garden doubles in size (fed growth included) and holds, and every second you pulse Thornlash damage around you. You cannot move or be moved. Recast to end it.

kit.name: Born Empty
kit.description: You use no resource, gain nothing from ability power, and cannot be revealed by any effect other than ordinary sight. Your next attack on an enemy champion who cast an ability in the last 3s deals bonus damage.

kit.name: Cudgel
kit.description: A blunt swing of the three-section staff, knocking back everyone it catches.

kit.name: Unmake
kit.description: Thrust the spear in a line. The first enemy champion hit has their active magic erased: shields stripped, buffs cleared, channels broken. Any planted object in the line is destroyed.

kit.name: The Short Chain
kit.description: Throw the chain. The first champion hit is bound for 1.5s: they keep their feet and may move, but crossing the leash snaps them back, and the first snap bites for half the damage again. A blink or dash across it breaks the chain.

kit.name: Name on the List
kit.description: Name one enemy champion, visible to both teams. For the duration their magic cannot damage or affect you, while their attacks and crowd control are unchanged. Their teammates are unaffected.

kit.name: Ink Pools
kit.description: Each ability hit on an enemy champion leaves a 1.5m puddle of ink under them for 4s (at most one fresh puddle per target each second). Enemies in your puddles are slowed by 15%. While you stand in your own ink (a puddle, Jet Away's cloud or Ink Tide) you move 20% faster and gain 4 mana per second.

kit.name: Ink Jet
kit.description: Squirt a jet of ink down a line, piercing: magic damage to everything hit.

kit.name: Reef Grasp
kit.description: Tentacles burst up in a circle after 0.6s: magic damage, enemies dragged 1 toward the centre and slowed by 35% for 1.5s.

kit.name: Jet Away
kit.description: Blast away from the cursor, leaving an ink cloud where you stood for 3s. Enemies inside are slowed by 20%, and the cloud counts as your ink.

kit.name: Ink Tide
kit.description: Flood a wide circle for 6s. Allied champions inside, you included, are hidden from enemies unless an enemy champion comes within 2.5 of them. Enemies inside take magic damage each second, and the flood counts as your ink.

kit.name: Needle Grin
kit.description: Every third basic attack on the same target tears a Stitch: bonus magic damage, and Oboro heals for 45% of the hit. A Stitched target stays Stitched for 4s. Hitting champions builds Malice; it drains out of combat.

kit.name: Unravel
kit.description: A lash of ink in a line. Minions and monsters it crosses are dragged toward Oboro and hurt; the first champion it reaches is hurt and pinned for 0.5s.

kit.name: Come Apart
kit.description: Oboro sheds a seam: a shield now, plus 1.2 per Malice spent, and the seam's own worth bleeds back out of him over 4s. The bleed cannot kill him.

kit.name: Skitter
kit.description: A short dash. Aimed at a Stitched champion it reaches almost twice as far, lands beside them and bites.

kit.name: Eat the Seam
kit.description: Oboro grabs a champion, swaps places with them and hurts them. For 4s every basic attack on them tears a Stitch.

name: Old Ren
title: The Dragon in a Child's Shape

kit.name: Older Than He Looks
kit.description: The first time Old Ren damages an enemy champion he hasn't hit in the last 10s, the hit deals bonus magic damage equal to 5% of their max health and Frightens them for 0.5s.

kit.name: Fang Cleave
kit.description: Chop a 120-degree, 3 m arc for 75/110/145/180/215 (+0.9 bonus AD) physical damage. Frightened enemies take 50% more, and hitting one refunds half the cooldown.

kit.name: Magma Arms
kit.description: For 4s gain 20% attack speed; basic attacks splash 1.5 m around the target for 40% of their damage as magic damage, and heal you for 20% of the damage they deal to champions.

kit.name: Ember Wings
kit.description: Glide 5 m, over walls, leaving a burning trail for 3s that deals 20 (+0.1 bonus AD) magic damage per second and slows 20%. Landing within 3 m of an enemy champion makes your next attack within 2s leap to its target.

kit.name: Coil of the Old Wyrm
kit.description: Mark a point within 9 m. After 0.75s the shadow of your tail closes in a 4.5 m ring around it: enemies inside take 150/250/350 (+0.8 bonus AD) magic damage and are Frightened for 1/1.25/1.5s away from the nearest point on the ring, so they flee inward and bunch in the middle. Everyone hit counts as fresh again and Fang Cleave is refreshed.

kit.name: Standing Orders
kit.description: A shell that damages no champion embeds as a Dud: it arms after 1s, lasts 20s, and detonates for 60% damage and a slow when an enemy steps near. Duds chain off each other, both teams can see them, and two hits defuse one. Standing still for 2s grants 10% damage reduction.

kit.name: Mortar Shell
kit.description: Lob an arcing shell onto a patch of ground, over walls and Gates. A shell that damages no champion stays as a Dud.

kit.name: Overcharge
kit.description: Your next shell within 4s deals 40% more damage over a 30% wider blast, and any Dud it leaves is a Big Dud with two charges and a wider trigger.

kit.name: Grapeshot Recoil
kit.description: Point-blank blast that knocks enemies back and pushes you the other way.

kit.name: Fire Mission
kit.description: Channel, then rain six shells over a large area at extreme range. Landing shells detonate any Duds they touch, and every shell that damages no champion leaves another.

kit.name: Ivory Scale
kit.description: Ire (0-100) is earned only in combat: 8 per basic attack, 10 per ability and 3 per champion hit you take, and it bleeds away out of combat. It gates nothing. Each third of the bar grows a bone-ivory plate on you (up to 3), each worth 8 armour and magic resist. When a stun, knock-up, fear, taunt or slow lands on you while you wear a plate, the plate shatters: that effect lasts 40% less, the shards deal 30 (+4 per level) magic damage to enemies within 2.5m, and it spends that third of your Ire. At most one plate shatters every 1.5s.

kit.name: Rend
kit.description: Rake the bone claw through a 90-degree, 3m wedge in front of you for physical damage. Each champion hit is Sundered for 3s (your basic attacks and abilities deal 12% more to them) and gives you 10 Ire. Hitting two or more champions refunds 2s of the cooldown.

kit.name: Horn Rush
kit.description: Lower your horned crown and charge 4m. Enemies in your path take physical damage, are shoved 1.5m to the side they stood on and are slowed by 30% for 1s. Hitting a champion gives you 20% movement speed for 2s.

kit.name: Ember Gob
kit.description: Lob a glob of burning pitch at a point within 8m. It lands after 0.6s, dealing magic damage in 2m, and leaves a pitch pool for 3s: enemies in it are slowed by 25% and take 20 magic damage per second. You gain 4 Ire per second while you stand in it.

kit.name: The Lair
kit.description: Tear your claw through the ground and burst out as the drake: enemies within 2.5m take physical damage and are knocked up for 0.5s, and all three Ivory Scale plates grow back. The torn ground is your lair for 5s (5m): enemies in it burn for 30/45/60 magic damage per second and are slowed by 20%. While you stand in it you are the drake: +250 max health, +0.5m attack reach, cleaving basic attacks and 20% less damage taken. Stepping out turns you back until your next lair. Dying as the drake grants the enemy team Wyrmslayer's Bounty.

kit.name: Star Chart
kit.description: Fall of a Star leaves a Star on the ground for 12s (up to 3). Allied champions near a Star are linked to it; the first time an ally is linked, and once per 10s after, they gain a shield of 30 (+8 per level) for 2s.

kit.name: Fall of a Star
kit.description: Drop a star on a point. After 0.5s it lands for magic damage and a 30% slow for 1s, and stays as a Star.

kit.name: Draw the Line
kit.description: Draw a line from every Star to an allied champion or himself. The ally is shielded for 3s, 25% more per Star drawn; for those 3s an enemy champion touching a line takes magic damage, once.

kit.name: Antler Step
kit.description: Stride through the void to one of his Stars, arriving 0.25s later and consuming it; enemies at the arrival are knocked up. With no Star in reach, a short stride toward the cursor.

kit.name: The Constellation
kit.description: Place a Star at his feet, then for 4s join every Star and every allied champion near him into one web of lines. An enemy champion who crosses a line is rooted, takes magic damage and is revealed for the rest of the cast, once per cast.

kit.name: The Toll
kit.description: Your bars are Toll Lines, striped lines on the ground both teams can see. An enemy champion who crosses one pays the Toll: 4% of their max health as magic damage, once per line. You gain what they paid as a shield (stacking up to 20% of your max health) that lasts 4s.

kit.name: Lower the Bar
kit.description: Slam the pole down along an aimed 5m line: 70/110/150/190/230 (+0.6 AD) physical damage and a 30% slow for 1.5s. The pole leaves a Toll Line there for 4s.

kit.name: Pay Up!
kit.description: Serve notice. Enemy champions within 3.5m are Dunned for 2.5s: one who gets 2m farther from you than where they were served pays a Toll at once (4% of their max health as magic damage, feeding your Toll shield) and is padlocked (stunned 0.75s), once each. Staying close and fighting you costs nothing. You take 20% less damage for 2s.

kit.name: Vault the Gate
kit.description: Pole-vault 5m in the aimed direction, over units. On landing, enemies within 1.5m take 60/90/120/150/180 (+0.5 AD) physical damage, and you drop the pole crosswise at your feet as a 5m Toll Line for 4s.

kit.name: The Tollgate
kit.description: Drop a long striped gate, 14m across, at a point within 8m, for 6s. It blocks no one. Every enemy champion who crosses it pays a heavy Toll (8/10/12% of max health as magic damage) and is slowed 50% for 1s; the first to cross is padlocked, stunned for 1s. While it stands your Toll shield cap doubles.

kit.name: Surplus
kit.description: You can only apply Bleed to champions whose maximum health is above your own, and each stack scales with the difference. Against anyone at or below your health you cannot Bleed and deal 15% less damage.

kit.name: Fleam
kit.description: Thrust the lancet down a short line, piercing everything it meets, for two stacks of Bleed and bonus damage to minions.

kit.name: Tourniquet
kit.description: For 4s, bleeding champions have their healing and shielding cut heavily and their stacks stop decaying, and you gain attack speed for each one near you.

kit.name: Barb
kit.description: Drive the barb into a bleeding enemy and pull yourself to them, damaging and crippling them. It cannot be cast on anyone you cannot Bleed. You also gain movement speed toward the largest health pool in sight.

kit.name: Bleed Them White
kit.description: Lock onto one bleeding champion for 5s. Their Bleed is pinned at five stacks and doubled, and you take far less damage from everyone else. Killing them refunds half the cooldown.

kit.name: Bar the Door
kit.description: Damage from your front arc is reduced by 20%, plus 2% per enemy champion facing you, to a maximum of 3. Damage from behind lands in full and reveals the attacker to your team. Frontal mitigation is disabled while your Open Door stands.

kit.name: Swing Shut
kit.description: Swing the door like a door on its hinge, sweeping a 150-degree arc 3 in front of you from your left to your right. Enemies swept take physical damage, are slowed by 30% for 1s and are carried 2 round the arc toward its right-hand end (walls stop them), ending bunched together.

kit.name: Open Door
kit.description: Plant the door standing open up to 4 away for 5s: two short panels, square to your aim, frame a 1.5 doorway. The panels block movement and dashes for everyone; the way through is the doorway. An ally who comes through the doorway gains 30% move speed and a 60 shield for 2s; an enemy who comes through is slowed by 40% for 1s and revealed for 3s. Your frontal mitigation is disabled while it stands.

kit.name: Hinge
kit.description: Brace for 2.5s, unstoppable. The first time each allied champion within 4 is hit by something in your front arc, you haul them 1.5 back toward your rear (walls stop them) and that hit is reduced by 40%.

kit.name: Knock Thrice
kit.description: Become unstoppable and slam the door three times, 0.6s apart, stepping 0.75m forward with each. Each slam strikes a 4m half-circle in front of you: enemies hit take physical damage, are slowed by 30% and are dragged 1m toward the door; enemies hit by the third slam are stunned for 1.25s. You can turn between slams.

kit.name: Deadening
kit.description: Every disable you land leaves a Deadened mark for 8s, to a maximum of three. Each mark cuts the duration of your next disables on that target by a quarter. Disabling a target with no marks refunds mana and shortens the cooldown.

kit.name: Dull Note
kit.description: One flat tone down a line, piercing everything it meets, for damage and a brief slow, with bonus damage to minions.

kit.name: The Felt
kit.description: After a short wind-up, a damping field settles on the ground. Enemy champions inside take damage and cannot cast, and may walk out at full speed.

kit.name: Dead Key
kit.description: Mark a champion for 1.5s. If they cast while it holds, the spell is lost on full cooldown and they are damaged and stunned. If they do not, half the cooldown is refunded.

kit.name: Dead Air
kit.description: Open a field on the ground, in range, in which no enemy champion may cast. While it holds you are slowed and cannot cast either, and it ends when you die. It deals no damage.

kit.name: Kekkai
kit.description: Your Q and W pin an ofuda talisman where they end (6s, at most 4). Any two within 7 are joined by a sacred rope: an enemy champion who crosses it is Bound, pinned for 0.5s (once per 6s each), and both talismans burn out.

kit.name: Burning Ofuda
kit.description: A talisman bursts on the first enemy it meets: magic damage and a 25% slow for 1.5s. An ofuda is pinned where it ends.

kit.name: Binding Circle
kit.description: Lay a ring of talismans. After 0.75s it closes: magic damage, and enemies inside are pinned for 1s. An ofuda is pinned at its centre.

kit.name: Paper Gale
kit.description: Burst into a whirl of talismans and reform 4 away, untargetable on the way. The ground you crossed flutters with ofuda for 3s, slowing enemies on it by 30%, with an ofuda pinned at each end.

kit.name: Kitsunetsuki
kit.description: The fox possesses an enemy champion for 1.75s: they cannot attack or cast, and walk themselves back along the path they took in the last 2s (walls and slows still apply; a Kekkai rope they cross still binds them). Then they take magic damage.

kit.name: Counted Strokes
kit.description: Each basic attack on the same target adds a Count (up to 5, shown over the target). Counts settle when you let go of that target, by switching or after 1.5s without a swing: the target then takes a delayed cut of 8% AD per Count as physical damage. A settle at 5 Counts etches a permanent tally mark worth 1% attack speed, uncapped and kept through death. Nothing strikes twice: the payoff lands when you let go.

kit.name: Held Flurry
kit.description: Hold for up to 1.2s: you walk forward at 40% of your movement speed and cut a 2.5m, 60-degree cone in front of you every 0.2s for physical damage. Bonus attack speed shortens the interval, down to 0.1s. Cuts on a champion add Counts. Release to end it early. You stay targetable throughout.

kit.name: Water's Edge
kit.description: Draw a 2.5m ring of still water around you for 1.5s; you move at 50% speed. The first enemy champion that walks or dashes into it, or strikes you from inside it, is answered at once by a cut for physical damage and slowed by 40% for 1s, and you gain 40% attack speed for 3s. It negates nothing: their hit still lands. If nothing breaks the water, 40% of the cooldown is refunded.

kit.name: Open Guard
kit.description: For 5s you gain 25% attack speed. Any target you bring to 3 Counts while it lasts has its guard opened: you deal 15% more damage to them for 4s.

kit.name: Last Tally
kit.description: Name an enemy champion within 6m. For 8s each of your hits on them carves a tally (up to 10, seen by both teams), and you move 30% faster toward them. Recast, or at the end if they are within 6m, to draw-cut through them and land 2m past, dealing 60 + 15% AD per tally as physical damage. If they die during the tally, you gain +1 attack damage and 5 tally marks permanently and half the cooldown back.

kit.name: Hoarfrost
kit.description: Every hit you land or take lays a layer of Hoar: on the enemy a stacking slow, on you stacking damage reduction, five layers each. An enemy at five is Brittle, and your next ability shatters them for bonus damage. Your own five call Hoarfall.

kit.name: Splinter
kit.description: Flick the frost off your blade: an instant 5 m line of ice shards that pierces, dealing 60 (+0.7 bonus AD) physical damage and laying 1 Hoar on each enemy hit. If it shatters a Brittle enemy, splinters burst from them and lay 2 Hoar on every other enemy within 2.5 m.

kit.name: Frostbrand
kit.description: Plant the sword. Enemies nearby are dragged a step toward the blade and held as the ground rimes over under them.

kit.name: Cold Snap
kit.description: Dash 4 m, laying 1 Hoar on every enemy you pass within 1 m and dealing damage. On landing, enemies within 2 m carrying 3 or more Hoar are stunned for 0.5s as the frost sets. No return.

kit.name: Hoarfall
kit.description: Needs five layers of your own Hoar, which are spent. The wyrm bursts from your back and dives on a point within 8 m after a 0.8s warning: 150/250/350 (+0.8 bonus AD) magic damage in 3 m and a 0.75s knock-up, and every enemy hit is set straight to Brittle. For 4s afterwards your shatters deal double damage.

kit.name: Chain-Bound
kit.description: Ability hits on enemy champions loop your fine chain around them for 4s. Your next basic attack on a chained champion yanks it: +12% of their missing health as bonus physical damage, and they are dragged 1m toward you (walls stop it). Once per chain, from any angle.

kit.name: Shadowline
kit.description: Fling your chain at a point up to 5m away and be drawn along it in 0.25s. Every enemy on the line takes physical damage and is Chain-Bound. If the line meets an enemy champion you stop 1m short of them.

kit.name: Hollow Fan
kit.description: Throw daggers in a cone for damage and a 30% slow. The centre dagger deals 50% bonus damage to champions.

kit.name: Veil
kit.description: Become untargetable and invisible for 1s, then gain 30% movement speed. You cannot act while Veiled.

kit.name: The Hollowing
kit.description: Mark the nearest enemy champion in range for 6s, gaining 40% movement speed and 20% bonus damage against them. Killing the marked target resets your cooldowns.

kit.name: Ripening
kit.description: The tip does the reaping. Your basic attacks and abilities deal +25% damage to enemies in the outer band of their reach (the last metre). Each tip-band hit on an enemy champion adds a Ripeness (held 6s); at 4 they are Ripe for 4s, a sheaf over them for your team, and your next ability hit on them deals bonus damage equal to 10% of their missing health.

kit.name: Swath
kit.description: Sweep a 180-degree, 3.5m arc: 70/105/140/175/210 (+0.9 bonus AD) physical damage. Enemies inside the tip band are pushed up to 1m outward, into the tip of your swing; champions caught in the tip band (2.5 to 3.5m) are slowed 25% for 1s.

kit.name: Threshing
kit.description: For 3s your basic attacks swing a 120-degree arc at full reach, hitting everything in it (the tip band still applies), and you gain 20% attack speed.

kit.name: Crowlift
kit.description: A flock of crows lifts you up to 3.5m toward the cursor. Landing, your blade sweeps a 2m circle: enemies hit take 50/80/110/140/170 (+0.6 bonus AD) physical damage and are slowed 30% for 1s. If an enemy champion stands in your Swath's tip band when you land, your next Swath within 2s counts its whole arc as tip band.

kit.name: Last Row
kit.description: Mark a 9m by 3m row ahead of you for 0.8s, then stride it at three times your speed, cutting everything in it once for 150/225/300 (+1.0 bonus AD) physical damage, +1% for every 1% of the target's missing health (up to +60%).

kit.name: Roll Call
kit.description: You count as a minion: towers target you with minion priority and you take less damage from them. Every allied minion that dies near you leaves a Name, granting +1 health and +0.2 attack damage permanently. Cannons leave three.

kit.name: Spearwork
kit.description: Stab with the broken spear, dealing double damage to enemies attacking an allied minion or tower.

kit.name: Shoulder to Shoulder, Lads
kit.description: Rally the nearby wave: allied minions take 50% less damage for 4s and follow you instead of the lane. Recast to send them back with brief haste.

kit.name: Not Today
kit.description: Swap places with an allied minion and leave them a shield worth 8% of your health.

kit.name: Field Promotion
kit.description: Plant the banner for 8s. Allied minions inside gain double health and damage and fight alongside you, allied towers inside fire faster, and each Name counts twice.

kit.name: Barbed
kit.description: Harpoon hits leave a Barb in the target for 5s. Your next basic attack on a Barbed enemy tears it out for bonus physical damage equal to 4% of their max health, healing you for 60% of that.

kit.name: Line Out
kit.description: Throw your harpoon 8 m. It stops on the first enemy, dealing 70/105/140/175/210 (+0.8 bonus AD) physical damage and leaving a Barb; walls do nothing to it. For 3s the line is played out (it snaps beyond 10 m): whenever the target is more than 6 m from you the line goes taut, slowing them 35%, and you move 20% faster while running toward them. Recast to reel it in early and refund 20% of the cooldown.

kit.name: Haul
kit.description: Swing the harpoon around you, dealing 50/80/110/140/170 (+0.6 bonus AD) physical damage within 3 m. Barbed enemies are dragged 1.5 m toward you and slowed 30% for 1s.

kit.name: Slip the Net
kit.description: Dash 3 m and shed all slows. For 1.5s, the next stun, pin or slow on you lasts half as long. Starting in the river, the dash is twice as long.

kit.name: Pull Up the Skin
kit.description: Become a seal for 8s: +40% move speed, immune to slows, pass through units, and +200/300/400 max health. Q and W are locked. Enemy champions you slide through take 80/120/160 (+0.4 bonus AD) physical damage and are knocked 1.5 m aside (once per champion every 2s). Recast to leap 4 m out of the skin, knocking up enemies within 2 m of the landing for 0.75s and ending the form.

kit.name: Unmoved
kit.description: Sera cannot be displaced by enemies: hooks, pulls, knockbacks, knockups and carries do nothing to her. Stuns, roots, slows, silences and blinds all affect her normally, and terrain still blocks her.

kit.name: Heaven's Palm
kit.description: An open-palm blow in a cone: physical damage, and enemies struck are pushed 150 units back.

kit.name: Hold the Gap
kit.description: Plant your feet and throw your wings out sideways for 2s. You cannot move, but can still attack and use Heaven's Palm. Your wings make a 3.5 m line across your facing that enemies cannot walk or dash through; allies and projectiles pass. Enemies whose dash or blink breaks on it are slowed 30% for 1s.

kit.name: Bring Down
kit.description: Seize an enemy within 2.25 m and drag them down to the ground at your feet: 70 (+0.4 AD) physical damage and a 0.75s stun. If they were mid-dash, the dash ends on the spot and the stun lasts 1.5s.

kit.name: The Descent
kit.description: Beat up into the sky for 0.6s, rooted, with the corridor drawn on the ground, then dive in a straight line to a point up to 8 m away. Enemies in the 1.5 m-wide corridor take 150/250/350 (+0.6 AD) physical damage and are shoved 1.5 m out to their side of it. The first enemy champion within 1.25 m of the end is pinned under you, stunned 1.25s. Killed in the air, you never dive.

kit.name: Moon Disc
kit.description: Kunai instead of mana: 12 on the disc, one regrowing every 3s. A kunai from an ability that hits nothing plants in the ground for 12s (up to 8). Walking over one picks it up (a kunai back and 15% speed for 1s); an enemy champion walking over one breaks it.

kit.name: Crescent Fan
kit.description: Throw 3 kunai in a fan. Each deals physical damage to the first enemy it meets; a champion takes at most 2 (the second for half). Kunai that hit nothing plant at the end of their flight.

kit.name: Moon Wire
kit.description: Draw silver wire between up to 3 planted kunai near you for 3s. Enemies who cross a wire take physical damage and are slowed by 40% for 1s.

kit.name: Wire Reel
kit.description: Fire a silver wire at the planted kunai nearest the cursor within 8m and be reeled along it at 16m/s (a real dash: a stun cuts it and dash blockers stop it). Enemies the wire crosses take 30 (+0.3 bonus AD) physical damage and are slowed 30% for 1s, and you pick the kunai up on arrival. With no kunai in reach the wire anchors in the first wall within 6m and reels you to its foot; with neither, dash 3m. Your next basic attack within 3s throws 2 kunai.

kit.name: Path of Moons
kit.description: Needs 2 planted kunai near you. Untargetable, blink from kunai to kunai (up to 6, nearest next), cutting every enemy on each stretch for physical damage (half for each stretch after the first), and pick them all up.

kit.name: Reluctant Courage
kit.description: When an allied champion within 6m drops below 40% health (once per ally every 20s), Suzu steels herself: 25% move speed while running toward that ally for 2s, and her next Closed Thrust within 4s deals 25% more damage and slows everything it hits by 30% for 1s.

kit.name: Closed Thrust
kit.description: Snap the umbrella shut and lunge 3.5m, stabbing everything in the line: 60/95/130/165/200 (+80% bonus AD) physical damage. Steeled by Reluctant Courage, it deals 25% more and slows by 30% for 1s.

kit.name: Rain Shelter
kit.description: Hold the umbrella straight up for 2s: every hit you take, from any direction, loses a flat 15/25/35/45/55 before armour and resist. Strong against many small hits, weak against one big one. You walk at 80% speed and cannot attack. When it closes (recast to close early) you shake the rain off: enemies within 2.5m are slowed by 25% for 1s.

kit.name: Catch the Wind
kit.description: Open the umbrella and ride a gust 425 units in any direction, backwards included. Landing shakes off the rain: enemies within 200 units are slowed 30% for 1s.

kit.name: Monsoon
kit.description: The umbrella opens to full size over you for 4s: a 4m dome that follows you. Allied champions under it take 25% less damage from enemies outside it. Enemies under it are slowed by 25% and pelted every 0.5s for 20/30/40 (+10% bonus AD) physical damage. When it ends, or on recast, the canopy snaps shut with a bat all round: 150/250/350 (+70% bonus AD) physical damage and a 1.5m push.

kit.name: Hold the Line
kit.description: You take 4% less damage per enemy champion near you, to a maximum of 16%; Close Ranks stacks on top, but at least 10% of every hit always gets through. Your attacks deal bonus damage to enemies facing away from you.

kit.name: Banner Strike
kit.description: Sweep the banner-spear in an arc, damaging and slowing everything in front of you, with bonus damage to minions.

kit.name: Close Ranks
kit.description: Lock shields for 2.5s. You and every allied champion within 3m of you take 8% less damage for each allied champion (you included) inside that 3m, up to 24%. You move 20% slower while the ranks hold. Blocks no projectiles.

kit.name: First In
kit.description: Charge in a line and stop on the first enemy champion, knocking them back and stunning them. Each ally you charge through extends the charge and grants you a shield.

kit.name: Sound the Charge
kit.description: Raise the banner and sound the horn: after 0.75s, enemies within 3.5m take physical damage and are knocked back 2m. For 6s every allied champion within 8m (you too) gains 25% move speed while moving toward the nearest visible enemy champion, and First In's cooldown is reset.

kit.name: Royal Jelly
kit.description: Her heals and shields leave allies Honeyed for 3s. An enemy champion who basic attacks a Honeyed ally gets stuck: slowed 15% for 1s.

kit.name: Honey Drip
kit.description: Lob a glob of honey at a point. Allies in it are healed; enemies take magic damage and are slowed 30% for 1.5s. The puddle stays 2s, slowing enemies 15%.

kit.name: Amber Shell
kit.description: Shield an allied champion or herself for 2.5s. When it expires, whatever is left heals them for 50% of it.

kit.name: Sting
kit.description: Loose the swarm at an enemy champion: magic damage over 3s, and their healing and shielding are cut 40% for 3s. The bees return and heal her for 30% of the damage.

kit.name: Sealed in Amber
kit.description: Seal one champion in amber. An ally is encased, untargetable and immune to everything but unable to act, then released with a heal plus 15% of their missing health. An enemy is encased, stunned and untargetable.

kit.name: Wind-Up
kit.description: Tock, a clockwork toolbox on spider legs, walks at her side and builds her contraptions. A contraption has 8s of wind and stops working when it runs down; her basic attacks wind her nearest contraption 2s, and Tock beside one winds it 1s per second. Tock can be broken (300 +40 per level health); while it is (20s) she cannot build.

kit.name: Hot Rivet
kit.description: Fling a red-hot rivet down a line: the first enemy takes magic damage, and it ricochets to the nearest other enemy for 50%.

kit.name: Cog Lobber
kit.description: Tock scuttles to a point within 7.5m and assembles a Cog Lobber (3 hits break it; one at a time). While wound it lobs a cog every 2.5s at the enemy champion you damaged most recently within 9m (otherwise the nearest enemy). Each cog lands on a 1.5m circle drawn 0.8s ahead for 60 (+0.3 AP) magic damage and a 20% slow for 1s.

kit.name: Big Wrench
kit.description: Swing the wrench through a cone: magic damage, enemies knocked back, and every contraption near her fully rewound.

kit.name: Prototype!
kit.description: Fire whatever is in Tock's lid, in a fixed loop of three shown over her head. Spring Boots: leap and land for magic damage and a 1s stun around her. Tesla Coil: Tock chains lightning between up to 3 enemies every 0.5s for 6s, slowing 20%. Steam Hammer: after 0.75s a giant fist slams a line for magic damage and a 1s knock-up.

kit.name: The Jar Takes Its Share
kit.description: The jar banks Ash from every hit you take and every blow you land. A hundred Ash hatches a Grub, to a maximum of three, and the count is visible to enemies. If you die, every grub you have placed dies with you.

kit.name: Spadework
kit.description: Swing the grave-spade. Enemies carrying one of your brood return Ash to the jar.

kit.name: Set the Brood
kit.description: Spend a grub and throw it onto an enemy. It rides them and eats, to a maximum of two per host. It dies to a single hit from one of their allies, or when it leaves your sight.

kit.name: Split the Lid
kit.description: For 4s, the next three champions to damage you in melee have a grub knocked loose onto them, riding only briefly.

kit.name: Open the Jar
kit.description: Carry the jar open for 10s. Enemies who come near are latched, every grub of yours eats faster, and your grip reaches across the map.

kit.name: The Dead Kneel
kit.description: Enemies you have slowed, stunned or taunted deal 15% less damage to you while it lasts.

kit.name: Cleaver Chop
kit.description: After a 0.25s wind-up, bring the cleaver down along a 4m line: 70/110/150/190/230 (+5% max health) physical damage and a 35% slow for 1.5s. Double damage to minions.

kit.name: Collect the Tithe
kit.description: Wrench tribute from everyone kneeling to you: every enemy within 6m that currently Kneels (slowed, knocked up or taunted by you) takes 50/75/100/125/150 (+3% of your max health) magic damage. You then gain a shield of 50/70/90/110/130 (+4% max health), plus 25 (+2% max health) for each enemy champion you collected from (up to 3), for 3s. With nobody kneeling you get the base shield only.

kit.name: KNEEL.
kit.description: After a 0.3s wind-up, stamp the greatsword’s pommel: enemy champions within 3m are forced to their knees, stunned for 0.6s (minions 1s), and you gain 8 armour and magic resist for each champion downed (up to 24) for 4s.

kit.name: Throne of Skulls
kit.description: Raise a throne of skulls within 6m. It erupts after 0.5s, knocking up enemies within 2m for 0.75s, and stands for 6s over a 5m court. Enemies in the court are slowed 25%. While you are in the court you heal 1.5/2/2.5% of your max health per second for each enemy champion inside. Recast beside the throne to sit: rooted and unstoppable, you take 30% less damage, and every enemy champion in the court is taunted for 1s (once per cast). Recast to stand.

kit.name: Margins
kit.description: Your abilities leave Ink Lines on the ground for 8s, visible to both teams (up to 5; the oldest fades first). An enemy champion who stands on a line or steps across one is Blotted for 3s. Your basic attacks on a Blotted target deal an extra 20 (+4 per level) (+0.25 bonus AD) magic damage.

kit.name: Underline
kit.description: Dash 4.5 m, dealing 60/90/120/150/180 (+0.8 bonus AD) physical damage to everything on the path. The path becomes an Ink Line. If it hits a champion, you can recast once within 3s to dash again at no cost.

kit.name: Strike Through
kit.description: Cut a 4 m line across your facing just in front of you, dealing 70/105/140/175/210 (+0.7 bonus AD) physical damage and slowing 40%, decaying over 1s. The cut becomes an Ink Line.

kit.name: Blot
kit.description: Flick ink in a 4 m cone: enemies hit are blinded for 1.25s and Blotted. Gain 20% move speed for 1.5s.

kit.name: Signature
kit.description: After 0.5s, every Ink Line within 12 m flares. Enemies standing on a line or inside the shape the lines enclose take 150/250/350 (+1.0 bonus AD) physical damage, +15% for every Ink Line you have down (up to +75%), and are pinned for 0.75s. All your lines are spent.

kit.name: The First Taste Is Free
kit.description: Your abilities apply Desire to their target, to a maximum of 3 stacks. Your next attack spends every stack for bonus magic damage and heals you for part of it. Spending three stacks leaves the target walking toward you briefly.

kit.name: Heartstring
kit.description: A whip-crack of heartstring in a line for damage and a stack of Desire. Landing it on a target that already has Desire refunds half the cooldown.

kit.name: Sweet Nothings
kit.description: Whisper to an enemy champion for 2.5s. While it holds, moving toward you grants them movement speed but increases the damage they take from you, and moving away slows them.

kit.name: Feint
kit.description: Dash 4m. Enemy champions within 3m who were moving toward you lunge at empty air: slowed 30% for 1s, and each gains a Desire stack. The spot you left is drawn for 1s. Your next 2 basic attacks deal +40% AD. No return.

kit.name: The Debt Comes Due
kit.description: Call in every Desire stack on every enemy champion within 8m. Each is reeled 1m toward you per stack (up to 3m, stopping a body short) and takes 70/110/150 (+0.25 AP) magic damage per stack; those with 3 stacks are also Smitten for 1s. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt and every stack is spent. A kill refunds half the cooldown.

kit.name: Colony
kit.description: Every allied minion within 6m takes a share of what would have hurt Vrass: 4% less damage per minion, up to 5 (20%).

kit.name: Halberd Sweep
kit.description: A halberd arc in front of him. Everything caught is hurt and Scented for 4s; his basic attacks on a Scented enemy deal 15% more.

kit.name: Royal Decree
kit.description: He slams the haft down. Enemies within 3m are slowed 35% for 1.5s and he takes a shield (60 + 6% max health) for 2.5s.

kit.name: Swarm Step
kit.description: A short dash on all six limbs. Enemies within 2m of the landing are hurt, and he gains 25% move speed for 2s.

kit.name: Sovereign's Reach
kit.description: He plants himself for 0.9s as a ring closes on him. When it closes, every enemy within 5m is dragged 2.5m toward him, stunned for 0.75s and hurt. Step out of the ring to escape it.

kit.name: Blooded Trail
kit.description: Attacks and abilities Scent enemies for 8s. Scented enemies trail wisps through fog, take 20% more damage from Tatters, and grant you movement speed when hit. Standing in a river removes Scent.

kit.name: Barbed Bolt
kit.description: A heavy bolt that Scents and marks the target. Tatters' next 3 attacks against it deal bonus damage.

kit.name: LOOSE! / HEEL!
kit.description: Send Tatters at a target, at double range against Scented enemies, or recall her to your side. She takes 30% less damage while returning.

kit.name: Caltrops
kit.description: Hop 2.5m back, away from the cursor, scattering caltrops in a 2m circle where you stood for 3s. The first time each enemy champion walks into them they take 40 (+0.4 bonus AD) physical damage, are Scented and are slowed 35% for 1.25s. If Tatters bites a target while it is slowed by the caltrops, the bite trips it (stunned 0.5s), once per cast.

kit.name: The Last Hunt
kit.description: Sound the horn for 8s. Every Scented enemy is revealed, Tatters gains attack speed and slow immunity, and you deal bonus damage to whatever Tatters is attacking. A Scented kill refreshes the duration.

kit.name: Full Draw
kit.description: Standing still for 1.25s nocks a Full Draw: your next basic attack reaches 1.5 further, deals 30% more damage and goes through its target into one more enemy behind it. Moving spends it; attacking does not.

kit.name: Glancing Shot
kit.description: Loose an arrow down a 9 line: physical damage to the first enemy hit. If it reaches a wall first it glances off once and flies on another 6, and the first enemy it then hits takes 40% more and is slowed by 25% for 1.25s. A nocked Full Draw is spent on the shot for 2 more range, and it goes through one more enemy.

kit.name: Pin Down
