kit.description: Shoot an arrow into the ground. After 0.4s enemies within 1.25 take physical damage and are pinned for 0.75s (longer with rank); twice as long beside a wall.

kit.name: Slip the String
kit.description: Hop in the aimed direction. Your next basic attack within 3s is a Full Draw.

kit.name: Standing Ground
kit.description: Plant your bow-stave at your feet and claim a 3m circle for 8s. Inside it you always count as standing still: Full Draw re-nocks 0.4s after each basic attack, and you have +1.5m attack range on top of Full Draw's. Each Full Draw arrow that hits a champion drives them back 1.5m; if stone cuts the drive short they are pinned for 1s (once per champion per cast). Stepping out of the circle ends it.

kit.name: The Land Answers
kit.description: Each of Yara's abilities leaves its pictograph painted on the ground for 4s. Within 2m of any of her paintings (or anywhere on her Road) she gains 12% move speed and regenerates 3% of her max mana per second. Enemies see only faded smudges - the language is hers; the threats stay drawn for everyone.

kit.name: "Tsel." (Stone.)
kit.description: She names the stone, and it agrees: after a 0.6s telegraph, a spine of rock erupts in a circle - magic damage and a 25% slow for 1s.

kit.name: "Ix." (The Runner.)
kit.description: Yara paints a beast and it runs: a loping pictograph travels up to 900 units in a line at deliberate, dodgeable speed. The first enemy champion it reaches takes magic damage and is rooted for 1.25s. The Runner is a projectile - bulwarks and projectile-blockers stop it dead.

kit.name: "Ul." (The Road.)
kit.description: Yara paints a road 7m long and 1.2m wide from her feet toward the cursor, lasting 4s. Allied champions on it gain 35% move speed and enemies on it are slowed by 15%. The whole road counts as one of her paintings, and a Runner loosed along it runs twice as fast. It needs no terrain; she still has no dash.

kit.name: "Ahau." (The Dawn.)
kit.description: Yara speaks a word this continent has never heard. After a 1s telegraph, dawn breaks over a 550-radius area up to 600 units away: heavy magic damage, enemies are blinded (attacks miss) for 1.25/1.5/1.75s and slowed 30% for 1.5s. Blind stops attacks only - abilities cast out of the dawn at full effect.

kit.name: Somewhere Safe
kit.description: Your buried Pips are hidden from enemies but chirp at anyone close and ripple the grass above them. Any reveal exposes a Pip permanently, after which a single hit destroys it and pays the destroyer. Six at a time, 90s each, and they trigger only on champions. You gain movement speed near your own Pips.

kit.name: Nip
kit.description: Bite at the shins, dealing 40% more damage to enemies your Pips have slowed.

kit.name: Wake the Neighbours
kit.description: 2 charges, 14s refill. Dig for 0.5s and bury a Pip at your feet. An enemy champion who steps near an armed one makes it squeak: it deals no damage, reveals them for 3s and wakes every other Pip within 6m. Those pop up (visible, one hit kills them) and run at the victim faster than a champion walks; each one that arrives deals 25 (+0.2 AP) magic damage and stacks a 10% slow (up to 40%, 2s), then buries itself where it stopped.

kit.name: Scoot
kit.description: A short hop. Landing near one of your Pips retrieves it, refunding the charge, and grants movement speed.

kit.name: Everybody Up!
kit.description: Every Pip rises and walks at the nearest enemy, revealed to both teams from the moment it stands, faster than a champion can walk, and destroyed by any single point of damage. Each one that reaches an enemy champion bites like a woken Pip. Standing Pips return to the ground after 5s.

kit.name: Four Eyes
kit.description: Every basic attack and ability that hits an enemy champion marks them for 8s. Marked champions are revealed to Zax alone, through fog, brush and invisibility. One eye of the mask lights per marked champion.

kit.name: Drawn Edge
kit.description: A short slash on one enemy within 250 units: physical damage. Against a champion, Zax steals 20% of their move speed for 2s and heals for 30% of the damage dealt.

kit.name: Sword Vault
kit.description: Plant the katana and vault onto it, hopping up to 350 units, then slam down: magic damage in a 250-unit ring, 60% more within the inner 100 units. Untargetable for the 0.4s of the hop.

kit.name: Long Edge
kit.description: After a 0.35s wind-up the blade extends to twice its length and sweeps a 150-degree arc out to 450 units: physical damage, and enemies hit are rooted for 1s (+0.15s per rank).

kit.name: Eyes Shut
kit.description: Close your mask for 6s. Your own screen drains to grey and marked champions burn through in cold blue (only you see it; your team's vision is unchanged). You gain 35% attack speed and 25% move speed, and your basic attacks on marked champions deal 30 (+0.3 bonus AD) bonus physical damage, refresh the mark and take 1s off Q, W and E. A marked champion dying adds 3s.

kit.name: Counterpoint
kit.description: Her hands keep the rhythm. Casting the opposite note from her last one (Bright Note after Low Note, or Low Note after Bright Note) within 6s lights a hand, up to four, and each lit hand makes her notes 10% stronger. The same note twice in a row, or 6s without a note, lets every hand go dark. With three or more lit her notes carry their bonus effect. Hand Unseen and Full Choir do not break the rhythm.

kit.name: Bright Note
kit.description: A ring of song heals allied champions around her, the most wounded of them 50% more. With three or more hands lit: they also gain 20% movement speed for 1.5s.

kit.name: Low Note
kit.description: A bass wave rolls through a cone: magic damage and a 25% slow for 1.5s. With three or more hands lit: enemies are also pulled 1m toward her.

kit.name: Hand Unseen
kit.description: Send one floating hand to a champion. An ally is held in a shield for 3s, and whoever breaks it is slapped (40% slow for 1s). An enemy is gripped after 0.5s: stunned for 1s and dealt magic damage. The hand cannot be lit until it returns, so at most three are lit while it is away.

kit.name: Full Choir
kit.description: For 4s an aurora moves with her. Allied champions inside heal every second; each enemy champion inside is Hushed (silenced for 1s) the first time and slowed 20% while they stay. She moves 15% slower while singing.
